courses.title: CHAPLAINCY (2028) – Cohort 21, 1st year (Hybrid)
courses.description: The first year of Upaya's two-year Buddhist chaplaincy training, taken online or in a hybrid format. Students attend core periods, intensives and a sesshin each year, meet mentors monthly, complete readings, volunteer chaplaincy hours and a final project, and receive lay vows (Jukai) in the second year. Places are by application.

courses.title: BEING WITH DYING: Professional Training Program for Clinicians in Compassionate Care of the Seriously Ill and Dying (In Person 2027)
courses.description: A week-long residential training at Upaya, founded by Roshi Joan Halifax, for physicians, nurses and other clinicians who accompany people through serious illness and dying. It teaches contemplative practices for attention, presence, ethical clarity and self-care, and explores the spiritual and existential side of grief, dying and death. Places are by application.

courses.title: G.R.A.C.E.: Training in Cultivating Compassion-based Interactions (In Person September 2027)
courses.description: A weekend training at Upaya in G.R.A.C.E., Roshi Joan Halifax's five-step practice (Gather attention, Recall intention, Attune, Consider, Engage and end) for bringing compassion into meetings with others. It is open to clinicians, caregivers, chaplains, teachers and anyone in a helping role; an online version runs the same weekend.
